name: verify_company
description: Searches official company dataset or corporate registry for legal entity status.

company_name.description: The name or alias of the company to verify.

name: verify_license
description: Checks regulatory dataset (e.g. OJK) for active licenses in regulated financial categories.

company_name.description: The registered company name to query against the regulatory license dataset.

name: check_bank_account
description: Verifies bank account details, identifying personal accounts, corporate accounts, or flagged suspicious accounts.

account_number.description: The bank account identifier or number.

company_name.description: Optional claimed company name to check for name mismatch.

name: analyze_website
description: Inspects website domain, HTTPS protocol, structure, and detects impersonation signals.

url.description: The target website URL to inspect.

name: analyze_claim
description: Analyzes promotional claims to detect unrealistic returns, zero-risk promises, or suspicious payout timeframes.

text.description: The promotional text, chat message, or investment proposal to analyze.

name: detect_scam_patterns
description: Matches extracted text against known scam pattern datasets (urgency pressure, credential harvesting, advance fee, etc.).

text.description: The content to evaluate against scam patterns.
